reasoning_content: Now let's try building the APK on the VPS as a test.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Build APK on VPS
c.exec_command("""export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export ANDROID_HOME=~/android-sdk
export PATH=\\$PATH:\\$JAVA_HOME/bin:\\$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:\\$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools
cd /opt/areloria/client
ls android/""")

print("Android dir exists")

c.close()
EOF
